Iron Mountain is seeking a detail-oriented People Operations Specialist to join our Human Resources team. In this role, you will be responsible for delivering accurate, timely Human Resources administration and providing first-line advisory support to ensure smooth day-to-day operations across Kuwait and the surrounding region.
You will work closely with employees, people leaders, internal Human Resources teams, and external outsourcing partners to maintain a positive and consistent employee experience.
q: 1+ of experience in Human Resources administration, operations, or a foundational advisory role, with strong proficiency in managing employee data, records, and benefits with precision.
Solid knowledge of local labor laws and Human Resources compliance processes, paired with the sound judgment needed to escalate complex employee relations or regulatory matters appropriately.

Proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, including people leaders, employee representatives, and outsourced service providers, alongside fluency in both English and Arabic.
r: li

Deliver Human Resources Administration: Maintain accurate digital and physical employee records, process Human Resources documentation, support local benefits administration, and generate standard reports to ensure seamless operational execution.
li

Provide Advisory Support and Collaborate: Offer clear, policy-aligned first-line guidance to people leaders on routine matters—including absence management, exits, conduct, and performance—while partnering with internal teams, employee representatives, and third-party providers to support consultation processes and a positive employee experience.
li

Ensure Legal and Policy Compliance: Align all Human Resources transactions and practices with local labor laws and company standards, proactively flagging regulatory risks and escalating complex or sensitive matters to senior colleagues or external counsel as needed.

The focus is on developing competitive, technically sound and profitable proposals while protecting commercial margins.

Demonstrated experience preparing competitive and profitable bids
Qatar/GCC market experience is highly preferred
Strong understanding of BOQs, specifications, drawings, unit rates, productivity assumptions and cost build-ups
Experience with both service/application pricing and material supply/rental pricing is highly desirable
Excellent analytical, negotiation and communication skills with strong attention to detail
